tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured,tested and supplied the equipment(s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements i.e One screening machine setup with Similar Capacity upto atleast 50% Of the quantity required in any one of the last 3years. The equipments offered for supply must be of The most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after 2015 and be in satisfactory operation for 12 months as on date of tender opening

If tenderer is a manufacturer, then manufacturer should submit at least Two Work Order of 15TPD Capacity along with their performance certificate from the concerned ULB of Rotary Screening machine of their manufacturer
Certificate of registration of the Company under the company act. If the bidder is manufacturer of machines then should possess SSI registration certification copy of same should be enclosed
Bidder Should Not be Black Listed or Initiated for Black List by ULBs In India
The Supplier should have ISO Certified Agency
Tenderer must submit Bank Line of Credit obtaining after tender Notification date Mentioning Indent No from a Nationalize Bank of Rs 19.02 Lakhs
Tenderer must submit profit and loss account and balance sheet for last 3 years
